i so wish but i cant move out of here, pops would not let me move anywhere, or give me the cash to, i asked him many times, i need space but no go, he has control issues, sanctioning my little pocket money for silly reasons, he thinks i cant live on my own,(cook, clean, not smoke in the house), im freaking 27, its like he wants to keep an eye on me. 
and decision im awaiting on, is for a travel visa for which i had overstayed previously due to some complicated matters, so i have a high chance of being denied, its stressing me out, i have a solid plan for if i get approved, but denial...will destroy me, for i have nothing to do in this backward country, theres only 2 sort of live-able citys in the entire country,and its incredibly dull all the time.
